backbone: Source-qualified PolyFormer with existing all-layer BE factors and complete member trajectories; M4

continuation.trainable: Existing intermediate attention/FFN private factors only
continuation.frozen: Common maps, stems, classifier heads, running statistics
continuation.native_validation_selector: Same validation NLL checkpoint rule for all arms; no outcome-based intervention time
continuation.dropout_and_grad_mode: Dropout off for every Stage B objective/guard; gradients enabled for objectives and disabled for guard evaluation; response separation cannot be random-mask noise

views.same_class_probe: Fixed10% sample of edges between fit-role labeled nodes of equal class removed
views.other_class_probe: Fixed10% sample of edges between fit-role labeled nodes of different class removed
views.normalization_tokens: Exactly native normalization and complete per-view polynomial token computation; costs charged
views.semantics: Supervised evidence removal, no causal or label-invariance theorem

group_rule.fallback_order: Class-only then global; no native supervised targets removed

guards.reference: Copied warm function on deterministic control roles
guards.optimizer_state: Accept commits corresponding moments once; zero step discards proposed parameter and optimizer-state updates

Same CE plus response redundancy with class-only groups
Same CE plus normalized class/group hidden cosine repulsion
Same CE plus source-qualified conditional feature redundancy
fixed_continuation_arms.role: Strong label-conditional redundancy prior; charge adversarial estimator

fixed_continuation_arms.objective: Same CE plus source-qualified normalized true-label input-gradient diversity
fixed_continuation_arms.role: Strong functional sensitivity prior; explicitly label any graph-domain adaptation and charge derivatives

control_qualification: DICE/FoRDE use competent source-informed fixed recipes qualified without pilot outcomes. If unavailable or weak stand-ins, no launch. Do not silently repair a published loss or use hidden tuning.
utility_references: M4 independently trained PolyFormer ensemble with competent packing

resource_accounting.utility_continuation: Matched paid budget and label visibility; additional cost counted

primary_development_screen.paired_sign_rule: Same improvement sign in all3 blocks

Permuted masks match: evidence semantics unsupported
Under10% proposals accepted: guarded adaptation not useful under this protocol
Utility reference matches more cheaply: no quality/cost advantage
No post-outcome rescue via new sites/groups/masks/losses/seeds
